brief: Kit of 9 square place tiles (or 3 land kits) for campaign scrap titles: Trail, Bridge, Cliff, Canal, Market, Rooftop, Fog, Ruin, Spire. Each a readable location vignette in trail-scrap language. Runtime may still overlay foe portraits — design tiles that work alone or as a backdrop plate behind a foe cutout. No baked text (UI supplies the scrap name).
styleNotes: Land 0 trail/bridge/cliff · Land 1 canal/market/rooftop · Land 2 fog/ruin/spire. Keep palette family coherent; differentiate silhouette. See scrapByLand in MarbleVoyageModels.makeCampaign.
promptSeeds: Set of nine colorful comedic fantasy trail scrap location tiles for a climb map: trail path, rope bridge, cliff ledge, canal, market stall scrap, rooftop, fog path, ruin arch, spire — bold silhouettes, pure white, no text --ar 1:1
sessionNote: Declined by Evan: the current dynamic overland battlemap no longer uses the fixed region/subregion scene structure assumed by this request. Do not produce Trail, Bridge, Cliff, Canal, Market, Rooftop, Fog, Ruin or Spire scenery merely to match legacy location names. Sky Dock and Treasure/Mystery/Shrine encounter markers remain valid because they appear directly on the battlemap; this rejection does not apply to them. Trail grid was already submitted before the pause; it is not an approved deliverable. Remaining eight regional grids were not submitted.
